authorization: User requested all 50 whole practice questions from Non-Linear Relationships 3A: Exponentials, Hyperbolas and Circles; teaching content excluded.
method: Ordinary promotion in isolated staging, verified once and published through a checked transaction.

classification.difficultyReason: The hardest parts combine two taught transformations, requiring students to coordinate reflections or a reflection and translation with curve direction and asymptote position. The supplied reference graph and specified points scaffold the sketching.

questions.mappingNote: The source directly assesses exponential sketches, intercepts, horizontal asymptotes and effects of bases, vertical factors, translations and reflections, matching exponential-transformations. Substitution and index evaluation support this task; no separate secondary skill is required.

previousLocalDifficulty.difficultyReason: Source Foundation exercise applying the taught intercept, asymptote and additional-point sketching method.

classification.difficultyReason: Match ten exponential graphs using reflection, direction, intercepts and vertical translations.

questions.mappingNote: The prompt, ten graph givens and equation bank are correct with the documented source correction. classification.difficultyReason: Students construct sketches from equations using the specified intercept, asymptote and point. The hardest part combines a negative exponent, external negative sign and vertical shift, requiring coordination of increasing behaviour, position below the asymptote and approach to it on the right.

questions.mappingNote: All six equations match the source. Intercepts are (0,3), (0,0), (0,7), (0,-5), (0,4) and (0,0); corresponding asymptotes are y=2, -1, 5, -4, 3 and 2; points at x=1 are (1,5), (1,1), (1,11), (1,-13/3), (1,7/2) and (1,-8). Short answers, worked substitutions, curve directions and asymptote approaches agree. Exact fractions are retained, and no rounding instruction is needed.
